concerns.text: The median‑split sensitivity sweep (FR‑007) recomputes the same Elastic Net regression (a continuous‑outcome model) on a binary‑coded version of the pain‑threshold variable and reports changes in β and R². Using a regression model for a binary outcome is a methodological mismatch; standard practice would employ a classification model (e.g., logistic regression) and appropriate metrics (e.g., AUC, accuracy). Reporting R² for a binary target can be misleading and may invalidate the claimed robustness assessment.
